args.query: MATCH (p:Player)-[:WON|:LOST]->(m:Match)-[:PART_OF]->(t:Tournament {name: 'Wimbledon', year: 2019}) WHERE p.name CONTAINS 'Federer' AND m.round = 'SF' RETURN m.id AS match_id, m.surface AS surface, m.round AS round, collect(p.name) AS players
MATCH (b:Bookmaker)-[:PRICED]->(m:Match {id: '2019-540-225'}) WHERE b.name = 'Pinnacle' RETURN b.name AS bookmaker, m.odds AS odds
MATCH (b:Bookmaker {name: 'Pinnacle'})- [pr:PRICED]-> (m:Match {id: '2019-540-225'}) RETURN b.name AS bookmaker, pr.winnerOdds AS winnerOdds, pr.loserOdds AS loserOdds

claims.text: Pinnacle gave Federer winner odds of 2.29 (i.e., 2.29 to 1) for the 2019 Wimbledon semi‑final.

args.summary: Pinnacle listed Roger Federer at winner odds of 2.29 to 1 for his 2019 Wimbledon semi‑final match (against Rafael Nadal).
